items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Freddy Jenkins was very personable... Otto Hardwick was in the band, called him Toby.

ctx.x: Freddy Jenkins. Freddy Jenkins was very personable. He was a personality man. Oh, he'd spin his arm, they'd play a solo. Otto Hardwick was in the band, called him Toby. Now, he mastered the soprano saxophone then. To me, he got a better sound than Sidney Bechet. And Johnny Hodges played some good soprano saxophone.

And they were playing "East St. Louis Toodle-Oo," and what's this tune: (sings) Dun-dun-duh-h-h--. "Chant of the Weed." that was Don Redman 's tune. That was one of the few tunes that I heard him play, that he didn't write. And I can't remember the entire program for the evening.
